description: A step-by-step form with selectable answers, keyboard shortcuts, validation and progress, built on UI SDK core and its radio, checkbox and input components.
moves: Questions enter from the navigation direction while the previous question leaves.
Each question’s title, description, answers and error arrive in order.
A single selection ring moves between radio answer cards.
The question number rolls and the progress fill grows on a spring.
Validation errors open beneath the answers.
keyboard: Moves through answers and navigation actions.
Moves between radio answers; moves focus between checkbox answers.
Goes back or forward outside radio and text controls, following reading direction.
Continues, or submits the last question.
Chooses an answer when matching shortcuts are enabled.
